basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Filipina, ekek (Ek Ek) adalah makhluk manusia mirip burung, manusia bersayap yang mencari korban pada malam hari, haus daging dan darah, terbang dan mirip manananggal tetapi tak dapat memisahkan tubuh; bedanya dengan wakwak, ekek berparuh seperti burung.
basis_claims.quote: In Philippine mythology, Ekek (or Ek Ek) are birdlike human creatures. They are winged-humans who search for their victims at night. They hunger for flesh and blood. They are usually described as flying creatures that look like the Manananggal, but are unable to divide or split their body in the way that the Manananggal does.

basis_claims.statement: The firefox (tulikettu, tulirepo or tulikko) is a mythical creature of the folklore of northern and eastern Finland, a fox whose tail sparkles with fire.
basis_claims.statement_id: Rubah Api (tulikettu, tulirepo, atau tulikko) adalah makhluk mitos dalam cerita rakyat Finlandia utara dan timur, seekor rubah yang ekornya memercikkan api.
basis_claims.quote: Firefox (tulikettu or tulirepo or tulikko) is a mythical creature in the folklore of northern and eastern Finland. It is a fox whose tail twinkles fire.

basis_claims.statement: According to folk stories the firefox lives far off in woodland hideouts or in the north, and very few have seen it; it is black by day but sparkles with fire by night.
basis_claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita rakyat, Rubah Api tinggal jauh di tempat persembunyian di hutan atau di utara dan sangat sedikit yang pernah melihatnya; pada siang hari ia hitam, tetapi pada malam hari memercikkan api.
basis_claims.quote: According to folk stories, the Firefox lives far away in hideouts in the woods, or in the north, and very few are said to have seen it. Firefox is black during days but twinkles fire during nights.

basis_claims.statement: The firefox gave its name to the northern lights, called "fox's fires" (revontulet) in Finnish; in Lapland it is told that its tail throws sparks when it brushes low branches or bushes as it runs, causing the northern lights.
basis_claims.statement_id: Rubah Api memberi nama bagi cahaya utara (aurora), yang dalam bahasa Finlandia disebut "api rubah" (revontulet); di Lapland diceritakan bahwa ekornya memercikkan bunga api saat menyentuh dahan rendah atau semak ketika berlari, sehingga menimbulkan cahaya utara.
basis_claims.quote: Firefox has given its name for northern lights which are called "fox's fires" (revontulet) in the Finnish language. In Lapland it has been told that the Firefox causes the northern lights with its tail which flings sparks when it touches low hanging branches or bushes while the fox is running.

basis_claims.statement: The flogdrake (Old Swedish floghdraki; Finnish louhikäärme; also elddrake or godsdrake) is a dragon type of Swedish folklore, and less so Finnish and Estonian: a wingless worm-dragon flying glowing across the sky like a streak of fire or a shooting star, living in mountain tunnels it bores.
basis_claims.statement_id: Flogdrake (Swedia Kuno floghdraki; Finlandia louhikäärme; juga elddrake atau godsdrake) adalah jenis naga dalam cerita rakyat Swedia (Swedish), dan sedikit dalam cerita rakyat Finlandia (Finnish) dan Estonia (Estonian): naga cacing tanpa sayap yang terbang bercahaya di langit seperti garis api atau bintang jatuh, dan tinggal di terowongan gunung yang dibornya.
basis_claims.quote: is a type of dragon in Swedish folklore, and to a lesser extent Finnish and Estonian folklore (see kratt), by analogy a variation of the Pan-European firedrake myth; it is a wingless worm-dragon that flies across the sky while glowing, looking like a streak of fire or light akin to a shooting star, while living in mountain tunnels that it bores.

basis_claims.statement: The flogdrake resembles the eastern dragon in flying without visible wings, but Germanic dragons are always evil; it comes flying in the evening sky amid sparks, like a golden stripe sweeping across it.
basis_claims.statement_id: Flogdrake mirip naga timur karena bisa terbang tanpa sayap yang terlihat, tetapi naga Jermanik selalu digambarkan jahat; ia datang terbang di langit senja dikelilingi bunga api, tampak seperti garis keemasan yang menyapu langit.
basis_claims.quote: Thus the flogdrake can be compared to the eastern dragon in that it can fly despite lacking any visible wings. Unlike eastern dragons, however, Germanic dragons are always portrayed as evil. It is said to come flying in the evening sky surrounded by sparks, looking like a golden stripe that sweeps across the sky.

basis_claims.statement: It is large and seemingly limbless, said to be shaped like a steelyard balance, essentially a long tadpole.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia besar dan tampak tak berkaki, dan bentuknya konon mirip timbangan dacin, pada dasarnya seperti berudu panjang.
basis_claims.quote: It is large and seems to lack limbs, but is said to resemble a steelyard balance in shape, essentially like a long tadpole.

basis_claims.statement: Galtxagorriak (singular Galtxagorrii), also called Galtzagorrii or Prakagorris, are a kind of iratxoak (imp) or house spirit in Basque folklore; the name means "red pants".
basis_claims.statement_id: Galtxagorriak (tunggal Galtxagorrii), disebut juga Galtzagorrii atau Prakagorris, adalah sejenis iratxoak (makhluk kecil) atau roh rumah dalam cerita rakyat Basque; namanya berarti "celana merah".
basis_claims.quote: Galtxagorriak (singular Galtxagorrii, Basque pronunciation: [ɡaltʃagoriak]), also called Galtzagorrii or Prakagorris, are a type of iratxoak (imp) or house spirit in Basque folklore. The name "Galtxagorriak" translates to "red-pants".

basis_claims.statement: They are described as tiny, sometimes winged humanoids wearing red pants that can be kept in boxes, pincushions and other containers.
basis_claims.statement_id: Mereka digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip manusia yang sangat kecil, kadang bersayap, bercelana merah, dan dapat disimpan dalam kotak, bantalan jarum, atau wadah lain.
basis_claims.quote: Galtxagorriak are described as tiny, sometimes winged, humanoids wearing red pants. In folklore, they can be kept in boxes, pincushions, and other containers.

basis_claims.statement: The Hatuibwari, also known as Agunua, was a dragon in the Solomon Islands in Melanesia.
basis_claims.statement_id: Hatuibwari atau Agunua adalah naga di Solomon Islands di Melanesia.
basis_claims.quote: The Hatuibwari otherwise known as Agunua was a dragon in the Solomon Islands in Melanesia.

basis_claims.statement: It has a human head, four eyes, clawed arms, bat wings, and a serpent body.
basis_claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini berkepala manusia, bermata empat, bertangan cakar, bersayap kelelawar, dan bertubuh ular.
basis_claims.quote: It has the head of a human, four eyes, clawed arms, bat wings, and the body of a serpent.

basis_claims.statement: In American folklore the hodag is a fearsome critter like a large bull-horned carnivore with a row of thick curved spines down its back.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Amerika, hodag adalah makhluk menakutkan mirip karnivora besar bertanduk banteng dengan deretan duri melengkung di punggungnya.
basis_claims.quote: In American folklore, the hodag is a fearsome critter resembling a large bull-horned carnivore with a row of thick curved spines down its back.

basis_claims.statement: The hodag's history is tied to Rhinelander, Wisconsin, where it was claimed to be found, and it features in early Paul Bunyan stories.
basis_claims.statement_id: Sejarah hodag erat dengan Rhinelander, Wisconsin, tempat ia diklaim ditemukan, dan ia menonjol dalam kisah awal Paul Bunyan.
basis_claims.quote: The history of the hodag is strongly tied to Rhinelander, Wisconsin, where it was claimed to have been discovered. The hodag has figured prominently in early Paul Bunyan stories.

basis_claims.statement: An ichthyocentaur is a centaur-like sea being with a human upper body, a horse's forequarters and a fish's tail.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ichthyocentaur adalah makhluk laut mirip centaur bertubuh atas manusia, bagian depan bawah dan kaki depan kuda, serta bagian belakang ekor ikan.
basis_claims.quote: is a centaurine sea being with the upper body of a human, the lower anterior half and forelegs of a horse, and the tailed posterior half of a fish.

basis_claims.statement: The afanc (Addanc) is a Welsh lake monster resembling a crocodile, beaver, dwarf or platypus, sometimes a demon.
basis_claims.statement_id: Afanc (Addanc) monster danau mitologi Wales (Welsh), mirip buaya, berang-berang, kerdil, platipus, atau iblis; di Britania Raya.
basis_claims.quote: is a lake monster from Welsh mythology. Its exact description varies, being described as resembling a crocodile, beaver or dwarf-like creature, or a platypus and is sometimes said to be a demon.

basis_claims.statement: It lives in Llyn Llion, Llyn Barfog, near Brynberian Bridge or Llyn yr Afanc on the Afon Conwy near Betws-y-coed.
basis_claims.statement_id: Tempatnya Llyn Llion, Llyn Barfog, dekat Brynberian Bridge, atau Llyn yr Afanc di Afon Conwy dekat Betws-y-coed.
basis_claims.quote: The lake in which it dwells is also uncertain and it is variously said to live in Llyn Llion, Llyn Barfog, near Brynberian Bridge or in Llyn yr Afanc, a pool on the Afon Conwy near Betws-y-coed that was named after the creature.

basis_claims.statement: Its very tough hide (sehr starke Haut) is hard to wound with ordinary weapons.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kulitnya sangat kuat (sehr starke Haut), sulit dilukai senjata biasa.
basis_claims.quote: Es besitzt eine sehr starke Haut, was es sehr schwer, wenn nicht gar unmöglich macht, es mit herkömmlichen Waffen zu verletzen.

basis_claims.statement: Akkorokamui is a giant octopus-like being in Ainu folklore associated with Uchiura Bay.
basis_claims.statement_id: Akkorokamui adalah makhluk besar menyerupai gurita dalam folklor Ainu, dikaitkan dengan Teluk Uchiura.
basis_claims.quote: Akkorokamui (Japanese: アッコロカムイ; Ainu: At-kor-kamuy) is a gigantic octopus-like cryptid from Ainu folklore, similar to the Nordic kraken, which supposedly lurks in Uchiura Bay in Hokkaido.

basis_claims.statement: Legend puts its body at up to a hectare in area.
basis_claims.statement_id: Legenda memperkirakan tubuhnya dapat mencapai luas satu hektare.
basis_claims.quote: It is said that its enormous body can reach sizes of up to 1 hectare (110,000 square feet) or roughly 100 metres (330 feet) or more across.

arkan-sonney.depicted_variant: Manx white fairy pig with red eyes and ears

basis_claims.statement: A fairy animal shaped like a white pig bringing fortune; seeing the lucky piggy is a good omen.
basis_claims.statement_id: Hewan peri berwujud babi putih pembawa keberuntungan; melihat lucky piggy pertanda baik.
basis_claims.quote: The arkan sonney is a type of fairy animal that takes the form of a white pig that brings good fortune to those who manage to catch it. It was even considered a favourable omen just to have seen the "lucky piggy".

basis_claims.statement: Fairy Tales From the Isle of Man (1951) by Dora Broome: red eyes and ears; changes size, not shape.
basis_claims.statement_id: Fairy Tales From the Isle of Man (1951), Dora Broome: mata dan telinga merah, ubah ukuran bukan wujud.
basis_claims.quote: In Fairy Tales From the Isle of Man (1951) by Dora Broome, the white pig is described as having red eyes and ears, and though it can alter its size it is not able to change its shape.

basis_claims.statement: The Barmanou is a bipedal humanoid primate cryptid said to inhabit the mountains of northern Afghanistan and Pakistan.
basis_claims.statement_id: Barmanou adalah kriptid primata mirip manusia berjalan dua kaki yang konon menghuni pegunungan Afganistan utara dan Pakistan.
basis_claims.quote: is a bipedal humanoid primate cryptid that is said to inhabit the mountainous region of northern Afghanistan and Pakistan.

basis_claims.statement: Its supposed range covers the Chitral and Karakoram ranges, between the Pamirs and the Himalayas.
basis_claims.statement_id: Wilayah jelajahnya diduga meliputi Pegunungan Chitral dan Karakoram, di antara Pamir dan Himalaya.
basis_claims.quote: The proposed range of the Barmanou covers the Chitral and Karakoram Ranges, between the Pamirs and the Himalayas.

basis_claims.statement: The Barmanou allegedly has human and ape traits, is known for abducting women, and is said to wear animal skins on its back and head.
basis_claims.statement_id: Barmanou konon berciri manusia sekaligus kera, terkenal menculik perempuan, dan dilaporkan memakai kulit binatang di punggung dan kepalanya.
basis_claims.quote: The Barmanou allegedly possesses both human and apelike characteristics, and has a reputation for abducting women and attempting to mate with them. It is also reported to wear animal skins upon its back and head.

basis_claims.statement: The Beast of Gévaudan (La Bête du Gévaudan) is the historic name for one or more man-eating cryptids that terrorised the former province of Gévaudan in the Margeride Mountains of south-central France between 30 June 1764 and 19 June 1767.
basis_claims.statement_id: Binatang Gévaudan (La Bête du Gévaudan) adalah nama historis untuk satu atau lebih kriptid pemangsa manusia yang meneror bekas provinsi Gévaudan di Pegunungan Margeride, Prancis selatan-tengah, antara 30 Juni 1764 dan 19 Juni 1767.
basis_claims.quote: The Beast of Gévaudan ... is the historic name associated with a man-eating cryptid or cryptids that terrorized the former province of Gévaudan ... in the Margeride Mountains of south-central France between 30 June 1764 and 19 June 1767.

basis_claims.statement: Contemporary witnesses said the attacks were by one or more tawny-russet beasts with dark stripes and a dark stripe down the back, with a tail 'longer than a wolf's' ending in a tuft.
basis_claims.statement_id: Menurut saksi mata masa itu, serangan dilakukan satu atau lebih binatang berwarna cokelat kemerahan dengan belang gelap dan garis gelap di punggung, berekor lebih panjang daripada serigala dengan jumbai di ujungnya.
basis_claims.quote: were said to have been committed by one or more beasts of a tawny/russet colour with dark streaks/stripes and a dark stripe down its back, a tail "longer than a wolf's" ending in a tuft according to contemporary eyewitnesses.

basis_claims.statement: It attacked with fearsome teeth and claws, looked the size of a calf or cow, and seemed to fly or bound across fields at its victims.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia menyerang dengan gigi dan cakar yang mengerikan, tampak sebesar anak sapi atau sapi, dan seolah terbang atau melompat melintasi ladang ke arah korbannya.
basis_claims.quote: It was said to attack with formidable teeth and claws, and appeared to be the size of a calf or cow and seemed to fly or bound across fields towards its victims.

basis_claims.statement: These descriptions could fit a striped hyena, a large wolf, a large dog or a wolfdog, but its identity is still debated and unsolved.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gambaran itu dapat cocok dengan dubuk belang, serigala besar, anjing besar, atau anjing-serigala, tetapi identitasnya masih diperdebatkan sampai kini.
basis_claims.quote: These descriptions from the period could identify the beast as a striped hyena, a large wolf, a large dog, or a wolfdog, though its identity is still the subject of debate and remains unsolved to this day.

basis_claims.statement: The cù-sìth (coin-shìth) is a mythical hound of Irish and Scottish folklore, cú sídhe; like the Welsh Cŵn Annwn.
basis_claims.statement_id: Cù-sìth (coin-shìth) anjing mitos cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish folklore) dan Skotlandia (Scottish folklore), cú sídhe; mirip Cŵn Annwn Wales (Welsh); di Britania dan Irlandia.
basis_claims.quote: is a mythical hound found in Irish folklore and Scottish folklore. In Irish folklore it is spelled cú sídhe, and it also bears some resemblance to the Welsh Cŵn Annwn.

basis_claims.statement: Lives in rock clefts and roams the Highland moors; dark green shaggy coat; size of a small cow.
basis_claims.statement_id: Tinggal di celah batu, menjelajahi padang Dataran Tinggi (Highlands); bulu hijau gelap; seukuran sapi kecil.
basis_claims.quote: The cù-sìth is thought to make its home in the clefts of rocks and to roam the moors of the Highlands. It is usually described as having a shaggy, dark green coat with deeper green fur on the ears and more yellow fur towards the feet. It is said to be the size of a small cow

basis_claims.statement: Egg ghost, or dalgyal gwisin, is a Korean ghost resembling an egg.
basis_claims.statement_id: Egg ghost atau dalgyal gwisin adalah hantu Korea yang bentuknya menyerupai telur.
basis_claims.quote: Egg ghost refers to dalgyal gwisin (Korean: 달걀귀신), a type of Korean ghost. Its name comes from its resemblance to an egg. It does not have arms, legs, nor a head, not even eyes, nose, or mouth. Legend says that when a person sees an egg ghost, they will die. Its origin and personality are not significant.

basis_claims.statement: Its portrayal lacks arms, legs, head, eyes, nose, and mouth.
basis_claims.statement_id: Penggambarannya tidak memiliki lengan, kaki, kepala, mata, hidung, atau mulut.
basis_claims.quote: Egg ghost refers to dalgyal gwisin (Korean: 달걀귀신), a type of Korean ghost. Its name comes from its resemblance to an egg. It does not have arms, legs, nor a head, not even eyes, nose, or mouth. Legend says that when a person sees an egg ghost, they will die. Its origin and personality are not significant.

basis_claims.statement: Black Shuck tales belong to the folklore of Norfolk, Suffolk, the Cambridgeshire Fens and Essex; sometimes an omen of death, sometimes companionable.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kisah Black Shuck bagian dari cerita rakyat Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire Fens, Essex (East Anglia); kadang pertanda kematian, kadang teman; anjing hitam (Black dog), Old Shuck, Old Shock; Inggris (English folklore), Kepulauan Britania (British Isles); di Britania Raya.
basis_claims.quote: Accounts of Black Shuck form part of the folklore of Norfolk, Suffolk, the Cambridgeshire Fens and Essex, and descriptions of the creature's appearance and nature vary considerably; it is sometimes recorded as an omen of death, but, in other instances, is described as companionable.

basis_claims.statement: First printed mention by Reverend E. S. Taylor in Notes and Queries, 1850: a shaggy fiery-eyed dog visiting churchyards at midnight.
basis_claims.statement_id: Penyebutan tertulis pertama oleh Pendeta (Reverend) E. S. Taylor, Notes and Queries 1850: anjing hitam berbulu, bermata api, mengunjungi pekuburan tengah malam.
basis_claims.quote: The first mention in print of "Black Shuck" is by Reverend E. S. Taylor in an 1850 edition of the journal Notes and Queries which describes "Shuck the Dog-fiend"

basis_claims.statement: Black Shuck (der Alte Shuck) is a mysterious black ghost dog (schwarzen Geisterhundes) said to haunt Norfolk, Essex and Suffolk.
basis_claims.statement_id: Black Shuck (der Alte Shuck) anjing hantu hitam (schwarzen Geisterhundes) yang menghantui Norfolk, Essex, Suffolk.
basis_claims.quote: Black Shuck oder der Alte Shuck ist der Name eines geheimnisumwobenen schwarzen Geisterhundes, der angeblich in Norfolk, Essex und Suffolk spuken soll.

basis_claims.statement: The Borda is a legendary creature of the culture of Emilia-Romagna and other parts of the Po Valley in Italy.
basis_claims.statement_id: Borda adalah makhluk legendaris dalam budaya Emilia-Romagna dan daerah lain di Lembah Po, Italia.
basis_claims.quote: The Borda is a legendary creature that belongs to the culture of the Emilia-Romagna and other areas of the Po Valley in Italy.

basis_claims.statement: It is a kind of witch, blindfolded and horrible, that appears at night and on foggy days and kills anyone unlucky enough to meet her.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia semacam penyihir mengerikan bermata tertutup yang muncul pada malam hari dan hari berkabut, dan membunuh siapa pun yang malang bertemu dengannya.
basis_claims.quote: It is a sort of witch that appears, blindfolded and horrible, both at night and on foggy days and kills anyone who has the misfortune to meet her.

basis_claims.statement: It personifies the fear of swamps, ponds and canals, invoked by adults to scare children away from such dangerous places.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia personifikasi ketakutan akan rawa, kolam, dan kanal, yang dipakai orang dewasa untuk menakuti anak-anak agar menjauhi tempat berbahaya itu.
basis_claims.quote: It is a personification of the fear related to swamps and marshlands, and to ponds and canals, invoked by adults to scare children and keep them away from such potentially dangerous places.

basis_claims.statement: The Erdhenne ('earth hen'), also called Coluber domesticus, Erdhühnlein, Erdglucke, Erdglutsch or Herdhendl, is a German house spirit from the folklore of the Alp region, the Upper Palatinate and Bavaria.
basis_claims.statement_id: Erdhenne ("ayam betina tanah"), juga disebut Coluber domesticus, Erdhühnlein, Erdglucke, Erdglutsch, atau Herdhendl, adalah roh rumah Jerman dari cerita rakyat kawasan Alpen (Alp), Oberpfalz (Upper Palatinate), dan Bayern (Bavaria).
basis_claims.quote: alternatively called Coluber domesticus, Erdhühnlein, Erdglucke, Erdglutsch, or Herdhendl, is a German house spirit originating from German folklore of the Alp region, the Upper Palatinate, and Bavaria.

basis_claims.statement: The spirit appears as an old, ash-grey, shaggy short-necked hen; becoming visible, it foretells a death within a year, usually of the one who sees it; another legend says nine clucks and wing-flaps mean the head of the house will fall mortally ill.
basis_claims.statement_id: Roh itu tampil sebagai ayam betina tua kelabu abu berbulu kusut berleher pendek; penampakannya meramalkan kematian dalam setahun, biasanya orang yang melihatnya; menurut legenda lain, bila ia berkotek dan mengepakkan sayap sembilan kali, kepala rumah tangga jatuh sakit parah.
basis_claims.quote: the spirit appears as an old, ash grey, shaggy hen with a short neck. By becoming visible, the Erdhenne foretells death within a year, usually that of the person it shows itself to. However, according to another legend, should it cluck and flutter its wings nine times, the head of the house would fall deadly ill.

basis_claims.statement: This spirit's voice is said to come from the ground or a dark corner of the room, sounding like a hen clucking to her chicks, which gave it its name; like the Unke or the Hausotter (house snake), the Erdhenne is held to be a benign guardian spirit.
basis_claims.statement_id: Suara roh ini konon keluar dari tanah atau sudut gelap ruangan, terdengar seperti kotek induk ayam yang menuntun anak-anaknya, sehingga ia dinamai demikian; seperti Unke atau Hausotter (ular rumah), Erdhenne dianggap roh pelindung yang baik.
basis_claims.quote: Die Stimme dieses Geistwesens soll aus dem Erdboden oder einer dunklen Ecke der Stube dringen und wie das Glucksen, beziehungsweise Piepsen, einer Henne klingen, die Küklein führt, was ihm den Namen einbrachte. Die Erdhenne soll, wie die Unke oder die Hausotter ein gutartiger Schutzgeist sein

gulon.depicted_variant: Dog body with cat head/claws and fox tail

basis_claims.statement: The gulon looks like a mix of animals, usually dog-sized and dog-shaped with cat-like head, ears and claws, a thick shaggy brown coat and a fox-like tail.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gulon tampak seperti campuran berbagai hewan, biasanya seukuran dan sebentuk anjing dengan kepala, telinga, dan cakar seperti kucing, berbulu cokelat tebal yang kusut dan berekor seperti rubah.
basis_claims.quote: It resembles a hodgepodge of various animals, usually described as being the size and shape of a dog, with some cat-like features such as the head, ears, and claws. It also supposedly has a thick coat of shaggy brown fur and a tail resembling that of a fox.

basis_claims.statement: The jerff, modern spelling järv, is in Scandinavian legend a blend of animals resembling a dog with a cat's head and claws, a thick coat and a fox-like tail; in Germany it is Vielfraß and in English Gulon.
basis_claims.statement_id: Jerff, dalam ejaan modern Järv, dalam legenda Skandinavia adalah campuran berbagai hewan yang mirip anjing dengan kepala dan cakar kucing, berbulu tebal dan berekor seperti rubah; di Jerman ia dikenal sebagai Vielfraß dan dalam bahasa Inggris Gulon.
basis_claims.quote: En Jerff eller med modern stavning Järv, är inom skandinavisk legend en blandning av olika djur men som ska likna en hund, med huvud och klor av en katt. Den ska även ha en tjock päls och en svans liknande den på en räv. I Tyskland är varelsen känd som Vielfraß och på engelska heter det Gulon.

gonggong.depicted_variant: Human-serpentine water deity, red hair and iron forehead

basis_claims.statement: Gonggong is a Chinese water deity portrayed with human and serpentine features.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gonggong adalah dewa air dalam mitologi Tiongkok dengan ciri manusia dan ular.
basis_claims.quote: Gonggong (/ˈɡɒŋɡɒŋ/) is a Chinese water god who is depicted in Chinese mythology and folktales as having a copper human head with an iron forehead, red hair, and the body of a serpent, or sometimes the head and torso are human, with the tail of a serpent. He is destructive and is blamed for various cosmic catastrophes.

basis_claims.statement: His portrayal includes red hair and an iron forehead.
basis_claims.statement_id: Penggambarannya mencakup rambut merah dan dahi besi.
basis_claims.quote: Gonggong (/ˈɡɒŋɡɒŋ/) is a Chinese water god who is depicted in Chinese mythology and folktales as having a copper human head with an iron forehead, red hair, and the body of a serpent, or sometimes the head and torso are human, with the tail of a serpent. He is destructive and is blamed for various cosmic catastrophes.

basis_claims.statement: Gonggong is linked to great floods alongside his subordinate Xiangliu.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gonggong dikaitkan dengan banjir besar bersama bawahannya Xiangliu.
basis_claims.quote: Gonggong was credited in various mythological contexts as being responsible for great floods, often in concert with his minister Xiangliu (a.k.a. Xiangyao), who has nine heads and the body of a snake.

basis_claims.statement: In West Virginia folklore, the Grafton Monster is a cryptid reported around Grafton in 1964.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat West Virginia, Monster Grafton adalah kriptid yang dilaporkan di sekitar Grafton pada 1964.
basis_claims.quote: In West Virginia folklore, the Grafton Monster is a cryptid reported in and around Grafton, West Virginia, primarily associated with a cluster of sightings and local publicity in 1964.

basis_claims.statement: The creature is portrayed as very tall, pale, sometimes appearing headless and producing whistling.
basis_claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini digambarkan sangat tinggi, berkulit pucat, kadang tampak tanpa kepala dan bersiul ganjil.
basis_claims.quote: Descriptions vary by source, but the creature is commonly portrayed as a very tall, pale or light-colored figure, sometimes described as appearing headless and producing an unusual whistling sound.

harionago.depicted_variant: Roadside woman with hooked hair tips

basis_claims.statement: Harionago is a Japanese yōkai said to prey on young men.
basis_claims.statement_id: Harionago adalah yōkai Jepang yang konon memangsa pria muda.
basis_claims.quote: a yokai in Japanese folklore that preys on young men.

basis_claims.statement: She is said to appear on roads in Shikoku.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia konon muncul di jalanan Shikoku.
basis_claims.quote: Harionago appears along roads on the island of Shikoku as an attractive young woman with long black hair.

basis_claims.statement: Stories give her long hair tipped with hooks.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kisah-kisah memberinya rambut panjang berujung kait.
basis_claims.quote: The strands of her hair are prehensile and tipped with sharp barbed hooks.

indrik.depicted_variant: Bull body, deer legs, horse head, single snout horn

basis_claims.statement: Indrik (the Indrik-Beast) of the Dove Book and Russian folklore is a fabulous beast, king of all animals, living on "the Holy Mountain" where no other foot may tread; when it stirs the earth trembles.
basis_claims.statement_id: Indrik (Binatang Indrik) dalam Kitab Merpati dan cerita rakyat Rusia adalah binatang dongeng, raja segala binatang, yang tinggal di "Gunung Suci" yang tak boleh diinjak kaki lain; bila bergerak, bumi bergetar.
basis_claims.quote: is a fabulous beast, the king of all animals, who lives on a mountain known as "The Holy Mountain" where no other foot may tread. When it stirs, the Earth trembles.

basis_claims.statement: It is described as a gigantic bull with deer legs, a horse head and an enormous horn on its snout, vaguely like a rhinoceros.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan sebagai banteng raksasa berkaki rusa, berkepala kuda, dan bercula besar di moncong, agak mirip badak.
basis_claims.quote: It is described as a gigantic bull with legs of a deer, the head of a horse and an enormous horn in its snout, making it vaguely similar to a rhinoceros.

acalica.depicted_variant: A small wizened elderly man, a Bolivian weather spirit, standing at the entrance of a rocky cave while rain clouds pass overhead. Short human proportions, deeply lined face, simple modest earth-toned clothing. No wings or horns.

basis_claims.statement: Acalica are mythological creatures (sometimes called 'weather-fairies') from Bolivia.
basis_claims.statement_id: Acalica adalah makhluk mitologi yang kadang disebut peri cuaca dari Bolivia.
basis_claims.quote: Acalica are mythological creatures (sometimes called "weather-fairies") from Bolivia.

basis_claims.statement: They are said to control the weather, live in caves, and are very rarely seen.
basis_claims.statement_id: Mereka konon mengendalikan cuaca, tinggal di gua, dan sangat jarang terlihat.
basis_claims.quote: They are said to control the weather, live in caves, and are very rarely seen.

basis_claims.statement: When they do appear they are said to take the form of small, wizened men.
basis_claims.statement_id: Saat muncul, mereka konon berwujud pria kerdil yang keriput.
basis_claims.quote: When they do appear they are said to take the form of small, wizened men.

am-fear-liath-mor.depicted_variant: The Big Grey Man of Ben Macdui: an extremely tall, very thin dark-haired humanoid with unusually long arms and broad shoulders, emerging through Scottish mountain fog over gravel. Dark skin and dark body hair, no horns, no wolf face; distinguish the tall thin build from a bulky Bigfoot.

basis_claims.statement: In Scottish folklore Am Fear Liath Mòr (Scottish Gaelic, Big Grey Man; Big Grey Man of Ben Macdui, Greyman) is a cryptid of Ben Macdui in the Cairngorms, second highest in the British Isles after Ben Nevis.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia (Scottish folklore), Am Fear Liath Mòr (Gaelik Skotlandia, Scottish Gaelic, Lelaki Kelabu Besar; Big Grey Man of Ben Macdui, Greyman) kriptid di Ben Macdui, Cairngorms, kedua tertinggi di Kepulauan Britania (British Isles) setelah Ben Nevis; di Britania Raya.
basis_claims.quote: is the name for a presence or cryptid which is said to haunt the summit and passes of Ben Macdui, the highest peak of the Cairngorms and the second highest peak in the British Isles after Ben Nevis.

basis_claims.statement: Very thin, over three metres tall, dark skin and hair, long arms, broad shoulders.
basis_claims.statement_id: Sangat kurus, lebih dari tiga meter, kulit dan rambut gelap, lengan panjang, bahu lebar.
basis_claims.quote: It is said to be very thin and over ten feet (three metres) tall, with dark skin and hair, long arms, and broad shoulders.

basis_claims.statement: Usually unseen in fog; only crunching gravel and unease.
basis_claims.statement_id: Biasanya tak terlihat dalam kabut; hanya bunyi kerikil berderak dan rasa gelisah.
basis_claims.quote: Most often, the creature remains unseen in the fog of the mountain, with encounters limited to the sound of crunching gravel as it walks behind climbers and a general feeling of unease around the mountain.

amefurikozo.depicted_variant: The specific 1792 kibyoshi variant of Amefurikozo: a small humanlike yokai with ONE eye centered on the face, wearing a wide woven bamboo hat and a simple modest Edo robe, standing in rain on a Japanese path. Depict this one-eyed bamboo-hat variant only; no paper lantern or umbrella merging from another variant.

basis_claims.statement: Amefurikozō is a Japanese yōkai.
basis_claims.statement_id: Amefurikozō adalah jenis yōkai Jepang.
basis_claims.quote: Amefurikozō (雨降小僧, 雨降り小僧) is a type of Japanese yōkai.

basis_claims.statement: It appears in Toriyama Sekien’s collection and in kibyōshi.
basis_claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini digambar dalam koleksi Toriyama Sekien dan muncul pula dalam kibyōshi.
basis_claims.quote: There is a depiction of this yōkai in Sekien Toriyama's collection of yōkai drawing the Konjaku Gazu Zoku Hyakki, and they can also be seen in the kibyōshi among other publications of the same era.

basis_claims.statement: A kibyōshi from 1792 depicts it as one-eyed and wearing a bamboo hat in the rain.
basis_claims.statement_id: Salah satu kibyōshi tahun 1792 menggambarkannya bermata satu dan memakai topi bambu saat hujan.
basis_claims.quote: In the kibyōshi "Gozonji no Bakemono (御存之化物)" by Jihinari Sakuragawa and illustrated by Utagawa Toyokuni published in Kansei 4 (1792), when a man walks on a rainy night, a one-eyed amefurikozō wearing a bamboo kasa would step up possessing something in both its hands.

amomongo.depicted_variant: A hairy man-sized ape with visibly long fingernails, four ape limbs and no tail, at a cave near the forested foot of Mount Kanlaon, Negros. Natural ape face and posture, rough dark fur. No horns, clothing, weapons, or human-wolf hybrid anatomy.

basis_claims.statement: In Philippine folklore, the amomongo is a cryptid described as a hairy, man-sized ape with long nails; its name probably comes from Hiligaynon amó, 'ape' or 'monkey'.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Filipina, amomongo adalah kriptid berupa kera berbulu seukuran manusia dengan kuku panjang; namanya kemungkinan dari kata Hiligaynon amó, 'kera' atau 'monyet'.
basis_claims.quote: In Philippine folklore, the Amomongo is a cryptid described as a hairy, man-sized ape with long nails. The name is probably derived from the Hiligaynon word amó, which translates "ape" or "monkey".

basis_claims.statement: La Castellana residents in Negros Occidental see the amomongo as a violent wild creature living in caves near the foot of Mount Kanlaon.
basis_claims.statement_id: Warga La Castellana, Negros Occidental, memandang amomongo sebagai makhluk buas dan liar yang tinggal di gua dekat kaki Gunung Kanlaon.
basis_claims.quote: Residents of La Castellana in Negros Occidental view the Amomongo as a violent, wild creature that lives in caves near the foot of the volcanic Mount Kanlaon.

arkaroo.depicted_variant: One enormous natural serpentine being moving beside the pale salt expanse of Lake Frome toward the red rocky Gammon Ranges in South Australia. One snake head, one continuous thick legless body, long tapering tail; no wings, legs, horns or invented sacred symbols. The immense scale and landscape tell the water-drinking-serpent story.

basis_claims.statement: In dreamtime mythology, the Arkaroo is a serpent who drank all the waters of Lake Frome in South Australia.
basis_claims.statement_id: Pada masa dreamtime, Arkaroo adalah ular yang meminum semua air di Lake Frome di South Australia.
basis_claims.quote: In the dreamtime of Australian Aboriginal mythology, the Arkaroo is a serpent who drank all the waters of Lake Frome in South Australia, the latter remaining a large salt pan most of the time.

basis_claims.statement: The Arkaroo retracted into the mountains, carving the valleys of the Gammon Ranges in the northern Flinders Ranges.
basis_claims.statement_id: Arkaroo beristirahat ke pegunungan barat dan tubuhnya mengukir lembah-lembah Gammon Ranges di Flinders Ranges utara.
basis_claims.quote: Heavily filled and tired, the Arkaroo retracted for a nap into the mountains west, carving by his body the valleys of what is known today as the Gammon Ranges in the northern Flinders Ranges.

basis_claims.statement: Attacked by mystic beasts, water from his rests formed waterholes such as Arkaroola Springs.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia diserang makhluk mistis lain dan air yang keluar dari tempat istirahatnya menghasilkan mata air seperti Arkaroola Springs.
basis_claims.quote: He was attacked by other mystic beasts and let water on his rests, each position resulting in a waterhole, such as that of Arkaroola Springs and others.

azukibabaa.depicted_variant: An uncanny elderly Japanese woman yokai in a modest worn robe at the sheltered entrance of an abandoned rural temple on a rainy evening, holding a shallow bowl of red beans as an editorial evocation of bean sounds. Human anatomy, aged face, eerie listening pose; no horns or extra appendages.

basis_claims.statement: Azukibabaa is a yōkai associated with Miyagi.
basis_claims.statement_id: Azukibabaa adalah yōkai yang dikaitkan dengan Miyagi.
basis_claims.quote: Azukibabaa (あずきばばあ, "the bean hag") is a monster (known in Japanese as a yōkai) from Miyagi Prefecture in the Kanto region of Japan.

basis_claims.statement: It takes an old woman’s form and makes bean-like sounds.
basis_claims.statement_id: Wujudnya perempuan tua yang membuat bunyi seperti kacang.
basis_claims.quote: It is said to be an old woman who produces a sound similar to that made by azuki beans, which is referred to as azukiarai.

basis_claims.statement: A local story places the sound at an abandoned temple on rainy evenings.
basis_claims.statement_id: Cerita setempat menempatkan bunyinya di kuil terbengkalai pada petang hujan.
basis_claims.quote: Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture It is said that at the abandoned temple in Shimo-Kosaka-mura, the sound of azuki beans can be heard on a rainy evening.

bear-lake-monster.depicted_variant: A large serpent-like lake monster with short legs, each roughly eighteen inches long relative to the enormous elongated trunk, crawling out onto the stony shore of Bear Lake, Utah-Idaho. Show four short legs as an artistic anatomical choice, one reptilian head and a long tapering tail. No wings, horse head, or ocean ship.

basis_claims.statement: The Bear Lake Monster is an urban legend of a lake monster near Bear Lake on the Utah–Idaho border.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bear Lake Monster adalah legenda urban tentang monster danau di sekitar Bear Lake, perbatasan Utah dan Idaho.
basis_claims.quote: The Bear Lake Monster is a lake monster urban legend which appears in folklore near Bear Lake, on the Utah–Idaho border.

basis_claims.statement: Folklorists say it resembles a serpent with legs about eighteen inches long, roaming the shore.
basis_claims.statement_id: Menurut para folklorist, ia mirip ular tetapi berkaki sekitar delapan belas inci yang dipakainya berkeliaran di tepi danau.
basis_claims.quote: is reported to resemble a serpent, but with legs about eighteen inches [46 cm] long on which it marauds along the shoreline.

bobbi-bobbi.depicted_variant: A single huge snake suspended in the cloud-filled heavens, representing Bobbi-Bobbi in Binbinga Dreamtime accounts. One natural snake head, smooth continuous legless coiling body and tapering tail, no dragon horns or feathers. Warm high clouds and a distant northern Australian landscape. No borrowed Aboriginal dot-painting motifs or invented ritual symbols.

basis_claims.statement: Bobbi-Bobbi was a supernatural being living in the heavens in Binbinga Dreamtime myths.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bobbi-Bobbi adalah makhluk gaib suku Binbinga yang tinggal di surga pada masa Dreamtime.
basis_claims.quote: In myths of the Binbinga people of northern Australia, Bobbi-Bobbi was a supernatural being who lived in the heavens in the Dreamtime.

basis_claims.statement: He was a huge snake similar to the Rainbow Serpent, initially benevolent to humans.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bobbi-Bobbi adalah ular raksasa mirip Rainbow Serpent yang mulanya baik hati pada manusia.
basis_claims.quote: He was a huge snake, similar to the Rainbow Serpent, and was originally benevolent towards humans.

b-yg.depicted_variant: The Boyg in its Norwegian giant slimy serpent variant: an immense glossy dark snake coiled across and completely obstructing a narrow rocky forest path. One snake head, continuous legless coils, no horns, wings or humanoid troll parts. Wet stones and northern conifers at dusk.

basis_claims.statement: The Bøyg (Norwegian Bøygen), also called the 'Great Bøyg of Etnedal', is a legendary creature of Scandinavian folklore.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bøyg (Norwegia: Bøygen), juga disebut "Bøyg Besar dari Etnedal", adalah makhluk legenda dalam cerita rakyat Skandinavia.
basis_claims.quote: also referred to as the "Great Bøyg of Etnedal" is a legendary gnome-like creature in Scandinavian folklore.

basis_claims.statement: It is a great troll from Telemark and Gudbrandsdalen, usually a giant slimy serpent blocking travellers; the name means 'bend', 'twist' or 'curve', and it appears in the tale of Per Gynt, basis of Henrik Ibsen's play Peer Gynt.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bøyg adalah troll besar dari Telemark dan Gudbrandsdalen, biasanya digambarkan sebagai ular raksasa berlendir yang menghalangi pengembara; namanya berarti "tikungan", "pilinan", atau "lengkungan", dan ia muncul dalam dongeng Per Gynt yang menjadi dasar drama Peer Gynt karya Henrik Ibsen.
basis_claims.quote: It is a great troll from Telemark and Gudbrandsdalen. It is commonly characterized as a giant, slimy serpent which stands as a hindrance to travellers. The name means 'bend', 'twist' or 'curve'. It appears in the fairy-tale of Per Gynt, the basis for Henrik Ibsen's play Peer Gynt.

basis_claims.statement: Bøyg, often called Bøygen ('the bent one'), is a supernatural being or troll in the form of a giant serpent in Norwegian folk belief; it can be invisible, tries to block and spoil people's ways, and is best known today from Henrik Ibsen's 1867 play Peer Gynt.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bøyg, sering disebut Bøygen ("yang membungkuk"), adalah makhluk gaib atau troll berwujud ular raksasa dalam kepercayaan rakyat Norwegia; ia bisa juga tak terlihat, berusaha menghalangi dan merusak urusan orang, dan kini paling dikenal dari drama Peer Gynt (1867) karya Henrik Ibsen.
basis_claims.quote: Bøyg, ofte omtalt i bestemt form Bøygen, det vil si «den som er bøyd», er et overnaturlig vesen eller troll som opptrer i form av en kjempeslange i norsk folketro. Skikkelsen, som også kan være usynlig, prøver å stille seg i veien og ødelegge for folk. I dag er figuren mest kjent fra Henrik Ibsens skuespill Peer Gynt fra 1867.

brown-man-of-the-muirs.depicted_variant: A strong short dwarf guardian on an Anglo-Scottish moor, wearing brown clothes, with red hair and very large bull-like eyes set in an otherwise human face. Stocky human body, heather and rocks; no bull head, horns or hoof feet. The brown attire, red hair and imposing eyes must read clearly.

basis_claims.statement: Brown Man of the Muirs, a dwarf of Anglo-Scottish border folklore, guardian spirit of wild animals.
basis_claims.statement_id: Brown Man of the Muirs, kurcaci folklor perbatasan Inggris-Skotlandia (Anglo-Scottish), roh pelindung hewan liar.
basis_claims.quote: In the folklore on the Anglo-Scottish border, the Brown Man of the Muirs is a dwarf who serves as a guardian spirit of wild animals.

basis_claims.statement: William Henderson, Folklore of the Northern Counties (1879); Robert Surtees, Sir Walter Scott; Great Rebellion; Newcastle; Elsdon; strong dwarf, brown dress, red hair, bull's eyes.
basis_claims.statement_id: William Henderson, Folklore of the Northern Counties (1879); Robert Surtees, Sir Walter Scott; Pemberontakan Besar (Great Rebellion); Newcastle; Elsdon; kurcaci kuat, berbaju cokelat, rambut merah, mata banteng.
basis_claims.quote: the "Brown man of the Muirs", a dwarf very strong and stoutly built, his dress brown like withered bracken, his head covered with frizzled red hair, his countenance ferocious, and his eyes glowing like those of a bull.

chernava.depicted_variant: Chernava, the Russian river maiden from Sadko: a human woman's head and upper body with ONE long fish tail instead of legs, beside a quiet river at dawn. Modest linen upper garment as an editorial treatment, unadorned natural face; long tail and broad fish fin fully visible. No wings or bird feet.

basis_claims.statement: In Russian folklore, Chernava is the Sea Tsar's daughter (or niece), spirit and personification of the river of the same name; a mermaid with human head and upper body and a fish tail, famed from the epic of Sadko.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Rusia, Chernava (Чернава) adalah putri Tsar Laut (atau keponakannya), roh dan perwujudan sungai bernama sama; ia putri duyung berkepala dan bertubuh atas manusia dengan ekor ikan, terkenal dari epos Sadko.
basis_claims.quote: is Sea Tsar's daughter (or, according to some versions, a niece), spirit and personification of the river of the same name. She is a mermaid. Her head and upper body are human, while the lower body is a fish's tail. Chernava is famed from her appearance in the epic of Sadko.

basis_claims.statement: On the wedding night Sadko did not touch her; while he slept Chernava became a river and helped him back to the human world; he woke on the shore of the river Chernava and rejoined his first wife.
basis_claims.statement_id: Pada malam pernikahan Sadko tidak menyentuhnya; ketika ia tidur, Chernava berubah menjadi sungai dan membantunya kembali ke dunia manusia; Sadko terbangun di tepi sungai Chernava dan kembali kepada istri pertamanya.
basis_claims.quote: On their wedding night he did not touch her. When Sadko was asleep, Chernava had transformed into a river, helping him to get into the human world. Sadko woke up on the shore of the river Chernava and rejoined his first wife.

cliodhna.depicted_variant: Cliodhna in the County Cork beauty-and-healing-birds tradition: a dignified adult woman in a flowing modest cloak beside coastal rocks, with EXACTLY THREE small songbirds visibly perched near her. One bird on a rock at her left and two spaced on a branch at her right. Birds not wings growing from her body; no crown required. Soft Atlantic light.

basis_claims.statement: In Irish mythology Clíodhna (Clídna, Clíodna, Clíona, Cleena) is a Queen of the Banshees of the Tuatha Dé Danann; Clíodna of Carrigcleena rules the sióga of South Munster (Desmond).
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Irlandia (Irish), Clíodhna (Clídna, Clíodna, Clíona, Cleena) Ratu Banshee (Queen of the Banshees) Tuatha Dé Danann; Clíodna dari Carrigcleena memerintah sióga di South Munster (Desmond); di Irlandia.
basis_claims.quote: In Irish mythology, Clíodhna (Clídna, Clíodna, Clíona, sometimes anglicised to Cleena) is a Queen of the Banshees of the Tuatha Dé Danann. Clíodna of Carrigcleena is the potent banshee that rules as queen over the sióga (fairies) of South Munster, or Desmond.

basis_claims.statement: In some myths she is a goddess of love and beauty, patron of County Cork, with three birds whose song heals.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam sebagian mitos ia dewi cinta dan kecantikan, pelindung County Cork, dengan tiga burung yang nyanyiannya menyembuhkan.
basis_claims.quote: In some Irish myths, Clíodhna is a goddess of love and beauty, and the patron of County Cork. She is said to have three brightly coloured birds who eat apples from an otherworldly tree and whose sweet song heals sickness.

basis_claims.statement: Her palace was in rocks near Mallow, Carrig-Cleena; Munster peasants saw her as benefactor.
basis_claims.statement_id: Istananya di tumpukan batu dekat Mallow, Carrig-Cleena; petani Munster menganggapnya pelindung.
basis_claims.quote: She had her palace in the heart of a pile of rocks, 5 mi (8.0 km) from Mallow, which is still commonly known by the name of Carrig-Cleena, and numerous legends about her are told among the Munster peasantry who considered her their benefactor.

basis_claims.statement: Music lulled Cleena asleep and a great wave swept her away; the spot is Tonn Chlíodhna, Clíodhna's Wave, near Glandore.
basis_claims.statement_id: Musik membuat Cleena tertidur, ombak besar menyapunya; tempat itu Tonn Chlíodhna, Ombak Clíodhna (Clíodhna's Wave), dekat Glandore; di pantai Irlandia (Irish).
basis_claims.quote: One of them treacherously played music which caused Cleena to fall asleep. Then a great wave came and swept her away. The place was then called Tonn Chlíodhna, "Clíodhna's Wave", which is near Glandore harbour.

selkie.depicted_variant: Human woman with removed seal skin

snow-lion.depicted_variant: White celestial lion with turquoise mane

basis_claims.statement: Kappa is an amphibious supernatural being and water spirit in Japanese folklore.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kappa adalah makhluk amfibi gaib dan roh air dalam cerita rakyat Jepang.
basis_claims.quote: Kappa (河童 river-child) is an amphibious supernatural monster and water spirit in Japanese folklore.

basis_claims.statement: A contemporary Japanese image shows kappa with green childlike bodies and round head dishes.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gambaran Jepang masa kini menampilkan kappa bertubuh hijau seperti anak dan memiliki cekungan bundar di kepala.
basis_claims.quote: Contemporary Japanese people typically visualize kappa as having green, hairless bodies shaped like that of a human child. They have smooth, circular dishes on their heads

basis_claims.statement: Contemporary depictions show birdlike beaks and turtlelike shells.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gambaran masa kini menunjukkan paruh burung dan tempurung mirip kura-kura.
basis_claims.quote: pointed beaks like birds, which are often yellow. On their backs, they have what looks like a turtle’s shell

basis_claims.statement: Kinnara is a Hindu and Buddhist mythological creature depicted as part human and part bird.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kinnara adalah makhluk mitologi Hindu dan Buddha yang digambarkan sebagian manusia dan sebagian burung.
basis_claims.quote: A kinnara (Sanskrit: किन्नर Kiṃnara) is a creature from Hindu and Buddhist mythology.  They are described as part human and part bird, and have a strong association with music and love.

basis_claims.statement: In Southeast Asian traditions female kinnaris have female body parts and swan wings and tail.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi Asia Tenggara, kinnari perempuan memiliki bagian tubuh perempuan dan sayap serta ekor angsa.
basis_claims.quote: kinnaris have the head, torso, and arms of a woman and the wings, tail and feet of a swan.

basis_claims.statement: Lamassu is a Mesopotamian protective deity.
basis_claims.statement_id: Lamassu adalah sosok ilahi pelindung Mesopotamia.
basis_claims.quote: is a Mesopotamian protective deity.

basis_claims.statement: Its hybrid form combines a human head, a bull or lion body, and bird wings.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bentuk hibridanya menggabungkan kepala manusia, tubuh banteng atau singa, dan sayap burung.
basis_claims.quote: having a human head, the body of a bull or a lion, and bird wings

basis_claims.statement: Pairs of lamassu sculptures stand at Assyrian palace entrances.
basis_claims.statement_id: Patung berpasangan lamassu ditempatkan pada pintu masuk istana Asyur.
basis_claims.quote: Assyrian sculpture typically placed prominent pairs of lamassu at entrances in palaces

lightning-bird.depicted_variant: Black and white impundulu bird form

basis_claims.statement: The lightning bird or impundulu is a creature in the folklore of the Zulu people in South Africa.
basis_claims.statement_id: Burung petir atau impundulu adalah makhluk dalam cerita rakyat suku Zulu di Afrika Selatan.
basis_claims.quote: The lightning bird or impundulu or thekwane (or izulu, inyoni yezulu) is a creature in the folklore of the Zulu people.

basis_claims.statement: The impundulu takes the form of a black and white bird summoning thunder and lightning with its wings and talons.
basis_claims.statement_id: Impundulu berwujud burung hitam-putih seukuran manusia yang memanggil guntur dan kilat dengan sayapnya.
basis_claims.quote: The impundulu (which translates as "lightning bird") takes the form of a black and white bird, the size of a person, which is said to summon thunder and lightning with its wings and talons.

basis_claims.statement: Luanniao, or luan, is a legendary spirit bird of Chinese mythology.
basis_claims.statement_id: Luanniao atau luan adalah burung roh legenda mitologi Tiongkok.
basis_claims.quote: 鸞（らん）は中国神話の伝説の霊鳥。日本の江戸時代の百科事典『和漢三才図会』には、実在の鳥として記載されている。

basis_claims.statement: The Shuowen Jiezi describes red coloring, five-colored markings, and a chicken-like body.
basis_claims.statement_id: Shuowen Jiezi menggambarkannya merah dengan tanda lima warna dan tubuh menyerupai ayam.
basis_claims.quote: The Shuowen Jiezi defines the bird as born from the sperm of Chìdì. It is red in colour with five-coloured markings. Its body is shaped like that of a chicken. It sings in the five standard pitches and appears when hymns of praise are sung to rulers. It also described the luan as being "the essence of divine birds".

okubi.depicted_variant: Giant female head with blackened teeth

basis_claims.statement: Ōkubi is a giant-headed yōkai in Japanese tales.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ōkubi adalah yōkai berkepala besar dalam cerita Jepang.
basis_claims.quote: Ōkubi (大首) (おおくび) (the giant head) is a Japanese yōkai.

basis_claims.statement: It is commonly pictured as a large female head with blackened teeth.
basis_claims.statement_id: Wujudnya sering berupa kepala perempuan besar bergigi hitam.
basis_claims.quote: Its image is mostly a huge female head and has the characteristics of a married woman's teeth painted black.

basis_claims.statement: Onikuma is a bear yōkai from the Kiso Valley tradition.
basis_claims.statement_id: Onikuma adalah yōkai beruang dari tradisi Lembah Kiso.
basis_claims.quote: An onikuma (鬼熊, literally "demon bear") is a mythological Japanese yōkai originating in the Kiso Valley in Nagano Prefecture.

basis_claims.statement: It is described as walking upright.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan berjalan tegak.
basis_claims.quote: It is a bear-like creature that has been known to walk upright.

basis_claims.statement: Accounts give it a size exceeding ordinary bears.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kisah-kisah memberinya ukuran yang melebihi beruang biasa.
basis_claims.quote: Onikuma continue growing and reach sizes much larger than even the largest natural bears.

basis_claims.statement: Its dwelling is said to lie deep in the mountains.
basis_claims.statement_id: Tempat tinggalnya konon jauh di pegunungan.
basis_claims.quote: They live deep in the mountains, far away from humans.

jimmy-squarefoot.depicted_variant: Tusked pig-headed biped with calico-wrapped feet

basis_claims.statement: Jimmy Squarefoot, a bipedal pig-headed creature of Manx folklore, Isle of Man.
basis_claims.statement_id: Jimmy Squarefoot, makhluk berkaki dua berkepala babi folklor Manx, Pulau Man (Isle of Man).
basis_claims.quote: In Manx folklore, Jimmy Squarefoot is a legendary bipedal pig-headed creature living on the Isle of Man.

basis_claims.statement: Ridden by a Foawr, stone-throwing giant of Cronk yn Irree Lhaa, husband of the Caillagh ny Groamagh; tusked pig-headed man or white boar.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ditunggangi Foawr, raksasa pelempar batu di Cronk yn Irree Lhaa, suami Caillagh ny Groamagh; lelaki berkepala babi bertaring atau babi hutan putih.
basis_claims.quote: He is thought to have once been ridden by an unnamed Foawr, a type of stone-throwing giant, living on Cronk yn Irree Lhaa who may have been the husband of the Caillagh ny Groamagh.

basis_claims.statement: Large feet wrapped in calico look square, hence the name Squarefoot.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kaki besar dibalut kain belacu tampak persegi, asal nama Squarefoot.
basis_claims.quote: Seine großen Füße sind mit Kaliko-Bändern umwickelt und wirken quadratisch, daher der Name „Squarefoot“.

basis_claims.statement: Kalavinka is an immortal Buddhist creature with a human head, bird body, and long tail.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kalavinka adalah makhluk abadi Buddha berkepala manusia dan berbadan burung dengan ekor panjang.
basis_claims.quote: is a fantastical immortal creature in Buddhism, with a human head and a bird's torso, with long flowing tail.

basis_claims.statement: The Japanese source compares human headed Chinese paintings with Japanese art giving the upper body a winged bodhisattva form.
basis_claims.statement_id: Sumber Jepang membandingkan lukisan Tiongkok berkepala manusia dengan seni Jepang yang memberi bagian atas berbentuk bodhisattva bersayap.
basis_claims.quote: 中国の仏教壁画などには人頭鳥身で表されるが、日本の仏教美術では、有翼の菩薩形の上半身に鳥の下半身の姿で描かれてきた。

krahang.depicted_variant: Flying loincloth-clad man with two winnowing baskets and pestle

basis_claims.statement: Krahang (กระหัง) is a male spirit of Thai folklore appearing as a shirtless man in a traditional loincloth who flies at night.
basis_claims.statement_id: Krahang (กระหัง) adalah roh laki-laki cerita rakyat Thailand yang tampil sebagai laki-laki bertelanjang dada bercawat tradisional yang terbang di malam hari.
basis_claims.quote: is a male spirit of the Thai folklore. It manifests itself as a shirtless man, wearing a traditional loincloth, who flies in the night.

basis_claims.statement: Krahang uses two kradong, round rice-winnowing baskets, to fly at night in rural Thailand, and often rides a long wooden rice-pounding pestle.
basis_claims.statement_id: Krahang memakai dua kradong, tampah bundar penampi beras, untuk terbang malam hari di pedesaan Thailand, dan sering menunggangi alu kayu panjang penumbuk padi.
basis_claims.quote: Krahang uses two large kradong (กระด้ง), round rice winnowing baskets, to fly in the night in rural areas of Thailand. It also often rides a sak tam khao (สากตำข้าว), the long wooden pestle of a traditional manual rice pounder.

basis_claims.statement: A leprechaun (Irish: leipreachán) is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, a solitary fairy, a little bearded man of mischief, and a shoemaker with a pot of gold at the rainbow's end.
basis_claims.statement_id: Leprechaun (Irish: leipreachán) adalah makhluk gaib kecil cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish folklore), peri penyendiri (solitary fairy), lelaki kecil berjanggut yang usil, dan pembuat sepatu dengan sepanci emas di ujung pelangi.
basis_claims.quote: A leprechaun (Irish: lucharachán/leipreachán/luchorpán ) is a diminutive supernatural being in Irish folklore, classed by some as a type of solitary fairy. They are usually depicted as little bearded men, wearing a coat and hat, who partake in mischief. In later times, they have been depicted as shoe-makers who have a hidden pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.

basis_claims.statement: The leprechaun is a solitary creature whose main work is making and cobbling shoes and who enjoys practical jokes.
basis_claims.statement_id: Leprechaun adalah makhluk penyendiri (solitary) yang pekerjaan utamanya membuat dan menambal sepatu (shoes) dan gemar bercanda.
basis_claims.quote: The leprechaun is said to be a solitary creature, whose principal occupation is making and cobbling shoes, and who enjoys practical jokes.

basis_claims.statement: Before the 20th century the leprechaun was generally held to wear red, not green.
basis_claims.statement_id: Sebelum abad ke-20 leprechaun umumnya dianggap berpakaian merah (red), bukan hijau (green).
basis_claims.quote: Before the 20th century, it was generally held that the leprechaun wore red, not green.

likho.depicted_variant: One-eyed skinny old woman in black

basis_claims.statement: Likho (Polish licho) embodies evil fate and misfortune in Slavic mythology, a one-eyed creature often shown as a skinny old woman in black (One-eyed Likho) or an evil male forest goblin.
basis_claims.statement_id: Likho (Лихо, Polandia licho) adalah perwujudan nasib buruk dan kemalangan dalam mitologi Slavia, makhluk bermata satu yang sering digambarkan sebagai perempuan tua kurus berpakaian hitam (Likho Bermata Satu) atau goblin hutan laki-laki yang jahat.
basis_claims.quote: is an embodiment of evil fate and misfortune in Slavic mythology. A creature with one eye who is often depicted as an old, skinny woman in black (Лихо одноглазое, One-eyed Likho) or as an evil male goblin of forests.

basis_claims.statement: In the Russian folk tale "One-eyed Likho" it appears as a thin, one-eyed, man-eating giantess.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam dongeng rakyat Rusia "Likho Bermata Satu", Likho tampil sebagai raksasa perempuan kurus bermata satu pemakan manusia.
basis_claims.quote: В русской народной сказке «Лихо одноглазое» предстаёт в образе худой одноглазой великанши-людоедки.

llamhigyn-y-dwr.depicted_variant: Legless frog with bat wings and stinging lizard tail

basis_claims.statement: Llamhigyn y Dŵr (Welsh for Water Leaper) is an evil creature of Welsh folklore of swamps and ponds.
basis_claims.statement_id: Llamhigyn y Dŵr (Wales/Welsh: Water Leaper, Pelompat Air) makhluk jahat cerita rakyat Wales, di rawa dan kolam; di Britania Raya.
basis_claims.quote: Llamhigyn y Dŵr (Welsh for 'Water Leaper') is an evil creature from Welsh folklore that lived in swamps and ponds.

basis_claims.statement: A giant frog with bat's wings, no legs, a lizard tail with a sting; leaps over water on its wings.
basis_claims.statement_id: Katak raksasa bersayap kelelawar, tanpa kaki, ekor kadal bersengat; melompat di air dengan sayap.
basis_claims.quote: It is described as a giant frog with a bat's wings and zero legs whatsoever, and a long, lizard-like tail with a stinger at the end. It jumps across the water using its wings, hence its name.

basis_claims.statement: A giant frog (grenouille géante) with bat (chauve-souris) wings for forelegs, no hind legs, a stinging lizard (lézard) tail.
basis_claims.statement_id: Katak raksasa (grenouille géante), sayap kelelawar (chauve-souris) menggantikan kaki depan, tanpa kaki belakang, ekor kadal (lézard) bersengat.
basis_claims.quote: Il est décrit comme une grenouille géante avec des ailes de chauve-souris à la place des pattes avant, sans pattes arrière et avec une longue queue de lézard avec un dard à la fin.

basis_claims.statement: A matagot is a spirit of French folklore that usually takes the form of a black cat.
basis_claims.statement_id: Matagot adalah roh dalam cerita rakyat Prancis yang biasanya berwujud kucing hitam.
basis_claims.quote: A Matagot is a spirit in French folklore that tends to take the form of a black cat.

basis_claims.statement: Matagots are generally evil, but some help, like the 'magician cat' that brings wealth to a home if well fed.
basis_claims.statement_id: Matagot umumnya jahat, tetapi sebagian dapat membantu, seperti "kucing penyihir" yang membawa kekayaan ke rumah bila diberi makan dengan baik.
basis_claims.quote: Matagots are generally evil, but some may prove helpful, like the "magician cat" said to bring wealth into a home if it is well fed.

basis_claims.statement: It roams mysterious places at night and returns at dawn with gold louis for its master; if neglected or unrewarded it takes offence and may take cruel revenge.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia berkeliaran di tempat misterius pada malam hari dan pulang saat fajar membawa koin emas louis untuk tuannya; bila diabaikan atau tidak diberi imbalan, ia tersinggung dan dapat membalas dengan kejam.
basis_claims.quote: Il est censé se promener dans quelques lieux mystérieux pendant la nuit, et revenir à l'aube avec un stock de louis d'or pour son maître. Si celui-ci le néglige ou ne le récompense pas, le chat s'offense et peut se venger cruellement.

mongolian-death-worm.depicted_variant: Bright red headless legless sausage-shaped worm

basis_claims.statement: The Mongolian death worm is a creature alleged to live in the Gobi Desert.
basis_claims.statement_id: Cacing maut Mongolia adalah makhluk yang konon hidup di Gurun Gobi.
basis_claims.quote: is a creature alleged to exist in the Gobi Desert.

basis_claims.statement: It is shaped like a sausage about two feet long, with no head or legs, and so poisonous that touching it means instant death.
basis_claims.statement_id: Bentuknya seperti sosis sepanjang sekitar dua kaki, tanpa kepala dan kaki, dan begitu beracun sehingga menyentuhnya berarti mati seketika.
basis_claims.quote: It is shaped like a sausage about two feet long, has no head nor legs and is so poisonous that merely to touch it means instant death.

basis_claims.statement: The worm is described as fat and bright red, 0.6 to 1.5 metres long.
basis_claims.statement_id: Cacing ini bertubuh gemuk, berwarna merah cerah, dan panjangnya 0,6 hingga 1,5 meter.
basis_claims.quote: Cacing ini bertubuh gemuk dan berwarna merah cerah, memiliki panjang 0.6 hingga 1.5 meter.

basis_claims.statement: Because it resembles a cow's intestine, locals call it olgoi-khorkhoi, "intestine worm".
basis_claims.statement_id: Karena mirip usus sapi, warga setempat menyebutnya olgoi-khorkhoi, "cacing usus".
basis_claims.quote: 牛の腸に似ていることから、現地ではオルゴイホルホイ（olgoi-khorkhoi、モンゴル語: олгой-хорхой、腸虫の意）と呼ばれている。

dullahan.depicted_variant: Irish Dullahan in the headless-rider variant: one fully clothed headless rider on ONE black horse, carrying his own ashen-pale head under one arm. The rider's raised collar ends in clean supernatural darkness, no wound or blood. Head has two fiery eyes. Whole horse with four legs visible on a misty Irish road; no pumpkin head or coach.

basis_claims.statement: The Dullahan (Dubhlachan, dúlachán) is a legendary creature of Irish folklore, a headless rider on a black horse or coachman carrying his own head.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dullahan (Dubhlachan, dúlachán) adalah makhluk legenda cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish folklore), penunggang kuda hitam tanpa kepala atau kusir yang membawa kepalanya sendiri.
basis_claims.quote: The Dullahan (Irish: Dubhlachan; dúlachán, /ˈduːləˌhɑːn/) is a type of legendary creature in Irish folklore. He is depicted as a headless rider on a black horse, or as a coachman, who carries his own head.

basis_claims.statement: The Dullahan is also called Colainn Gan Cheann, 'without a head' in Irish.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dullahan juga disebut Colainn Gan Cheann, tanpa kepala (without a head) dalam bahasa Irlandia (Irish).
basis_claims.quote: The Dullahan is also called Colainn Gan Cheann, meaning "without a head" in Irish.

basis_claims.statement: In Croker's tale the head looks like a large cream cheese hung with black puddings, ashen pale, with two fiery eyes flashing like meteors.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Croker, kepalanya seperti keju krim besar dikelilingi puding hitam, pucat abu, dengan dua mata berapi (fiery eyes) yang berkilat seperti meteor.
basis_claims.quote: It looked like a large cream cheese hung round with black puddings: no speck of colour enlivened the ashy paleness of the depressed features; the skin lay stretched over the unearthly surface almost like the parchment head of a drum. Two fiery eyes of prodigious circumference, with a strange and irregular motion, flashed like meteors.

each-uisge.depicted_variant: Each-uisge in its full horse variant: one powerful unbridled horse emerging from a deep Scottish Highland loch, dripping coat and wet mane, all four ordinary hooved legs visible in shallow water, alert unsettling gaze. No rider, fish tail, wings, horns, or hybrid human parts.

basis_claims.statement: Each-uisge (Scottish Gaelic) means water horse; an Irish and Scottish water spirit, each-uisce/aughisky/ech-ushkya in Ireland, cabbyl-ushtey on the Isle of Man; horse-shaped, like the kelpie but more vicious.
basis_claims.statement_id: Each-uisge (Gaelik Skotlandia, Scottish Gaelic) berarti kuda air; roh air Irlandia (Irish) dan Skotlandia (Scottish), each-uisce/aughisky/ech-ushkya di Irlandia (Ireland), cabbyl-ushtey di Isle of Man; berwujud kuda, mirip kelpie tetapi lebih ganas.
basis_claims.quote: literally "water horse") is a water spirit in Irish and Scottish folklore, spelled as the each-uisce (anglicized as aughisky or ech-ushkya) in Ireland and cabbyl-ushtey on the Isle of Man. It usually takes the form of a horse, and is similar to the kelpie but far more vicious.

basis_claims.statement: The each-uisge lives in the sea and lochs of the Scottish Highlands and shapeshifts into a horse, pony, handsome man or giant bird.
basis_claims.statement_id: Each-uisge tinggal di laut dan loch air asin dan tawar di Dataran Tinggi Skotlandia (Scottish Highlands), dan berubah wujud jadi kuda, poni, lelaki tampan, atau burung raksasa.
basis_claims.quote: the each-uisge lives in the sea, sea lochs, and fresh water lochs. The each-uisge is a shape-shifter, disguising itself as a fine horse, pony, a handsome man or an enormous bird such as a boobrie.

el-hombre-caiman.depicted_variant: El Hombre Caiman of Plato, Colombia, in the explicitly recorded MAN'S HEAD / ALLIGATOR BODY variant: an adult man's head joining directly to a low crocodilian neck and four-legged alligator body with broad armored back and long reptile tail. No human chest, arms or extra crocodile head. On a muddy Colombian riverside, respectful non-comic painterly treatment.

basis_claims.statement: El Hombre Caimán ("The Alligator Man") is an urban legend of the Caribbean coast of Colombia, set in Plato: Saúl Montenegro, who spied on bathing women, became a being with a man's head and an alligator's body.
basis_claims.statement_id: El Hombre Caimán ("Manusia Buaya") adalah legenda urban pesisir Karibia Kolombia di kota Plato: Saúl Montenegro yang gemar mengintip perempuan mandi berubah menjadi makhluk berkepala manusia dan bertubuh buaya.
basis_claims.quote: El Hombre Caimán (The Alligator Man) is an urban legend from the Caribbean coast of Colombia that takes place in the riverside town of Plato: Saúl Montenegro's passion for spying on naked women turned into a being with the head of a man and the body of an alligator.

enenra.depicted_variant: Enenra, Japanese smoke yokai: a single loosely human-shaped figure made entirely of swirling dark gray smoke rising from a small rural hearth fire. Face, arms and body suggested by smoke rather than solid flesh. Soft luminous embers illuminate the transparent wisps. No horns, solid armor, demon wings or burning person.

basis_claims.statement: Enenra is a Japanese yōkai associated with smoke and darkness.
basis_claims.statement_id: Enenra adalah yōkai Jepang yang terkait dengan asap dan kegelapan.
basis_claims.quote: Enenra (煙々羅, en'enra; lit. "lightweight-fabric smoke"), sometimes enraenra (煙羅煙羅), is a yōkai, or Japanese monster, composed of smoke and darkness.

basis_claims.statement: Accounts describe it emerging from a fire in human form.
basis_claims.statement_id: Cerita menggambarkannya muncul dari api dalam wujud manusia.
basis_claims.quote: Enenras mostly reside in bonfires; when they emerge, they take human shape or form.

gallinipper-mythology.depicted_variant: Gallinipper tall-tale mosquito: one fantastically giant mosquito with exactly six long jointed legs, one pair of transparent wings, slim segmented abdomen and a long needlelike proboscis, beside tree trunks of comparable height in an American woodland. Mosquito anatomy, never a dragonfly, beetle or bird. No feeding or blood.

basis_claims.statement: The gallinipper is a cryptid of African-American folk tradition.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gallinipper adalah kriptid dalam tradisi rakyat Afrika-Amerika.
basis_claims.quote: The gallinipper is a cryptid in the African-American folk tradition.

basis_claims.statement: They were said to be giant mosquitoes whose bones could fence a 140-acre field.
basis_claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini konon nyamuk raksasa yang tulangnya cukup untuk memagari ladang seluas 140 acre.
basis_claims.quote: These creatures were said to be a species of giant mosquitoes so big that their bones could fence a 140-acre (57 ha) field.

basis_claims.statement: In a popular telling it pulls its bill from a tree trunk, clearing 140 acres in the struggle.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah populer, makhluk ini menarik paruhnya dari batang pohon dan membersihkan lahan 140 acre selama meronta.
basis_claims.quote: A popular telling of the legends has the creature get its bill out of a tree trunk, with the animal being large enough to clear 140 acres of land during the struggle.

gwyllgi.depicted_variant: Gwyllgi, Welsh phantom mastiff variant: one massive BLACK MASTIFF with broad heavy head and clearly glowing red eyes, four canine legs, natural tail, standing on a lonely stone-walled Welsh road at twilight. The complete dog silhouette is visible; no wolf-werewolf body, horns or fire breath.

basis_claims.statement: Gwyllgi (gwyllt wild / gwyll twilight + ci dog), mythical dog of Wales, phantom mastiff or black wolf, blazing red eyes.
basis_claims.statement_id: Gwyllgi (gwyllt liar / gwyll senja + ci anjing), anjing mitos Wales, hantu mastiff atau serigala hitam, mata merah menyala.
basis_claims.quote: compound noun of either gwyllt "wild" or gwyll "twilight" + ci "dog") is a mythical dog from Wales that appears as a frightful apparition of a mastiff or black wolf with baleful breath and blazing red eyes.

basis_claims.statement: Sightings in north-east Wales: Nant y Garth near Llandegla, Denbighshire; Marchwiel, Wrexham.
basis_claims.statement_id: Penampakan di Wales timur laut: Nant y Garth dekat Llandegla, Denbighshire; Marchwiel, Wrexham.
basis_claims.quote: Specifically, the Nant y Garth pass located near Llandegla in Denbighshire. It has even been spotted as far away as Marchwiel in Wrexham

basis_claims.statement: it article: The Dog of Darkness, The Black Hound of Destiny; appears on lonely roads at night.
basis_claims.statement_id: Artikel it: The Dog of Darkness, The Black Hound of Destiny; muncul di jalan sepi malam hari.
basis_claims.quote: Viene spesso chiamato "The Dog of Darkness"(il cane dell'oscurità) o "The Black Hound of Destiny"(il mastino nero del destino), i ritrovi prediletti per le apparizioni sono strade solitarie durante la notte.

wanyudo.depicted_variant: Burning cart wheel with human face at hub

yuki-onna.depicted_variant: Pale snow woman in white kimono

basis_claims.statement: In Indonesian folklore, Orang Pendek (Indonesian for 'short person') is the most common name for a creature said to inhabit remote mountain forests on the island of Sumatra.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Indonesia, Orang Pendek (bahasa Indonesia: 'orang pendek') adalah nama paling umum untuk makhluk yang konon menghuni hutan pegunungan terpencil di Pulau Sumatra.
basis_claims.quote: In Indonesian folklore, the Orang Pendek (Indonesian for 'short person') is the most common name given to a creature said to inhabit remote, mountainous forests on the island of Sumatra.

basis_claims.statement: Witnesses agree the primate is a ground-dwelling, bipedal ape with short fur, 80–150 cm tall.
basis_claims.statement_id: Para saksi sepakat bahwa primata ini adalah kera yang hidup di tanah, berjalan dengan dua kaki, berbulu pendek, dengan tinggi 80–150 cm.
basis_claims.quote: Consensus among witnesses is that the primate is a ground-dwelling, bipedal ape covered in short fur, standing between 80 and 150 cm (31.5 and 59 in) tall.

basis_claims.statement: Claimed sightings have occurred mostly in Kerinci Regency, central Sumatra, especially within Kerinci Seblat National Park.
basis_claims.statement_id: Penampakan yang diklaim sebagian besar terjadi di Kabupaten Kerinci, Sumatra bagian tengah, terutama di Taman Nasional Kerinci Seblat.
basis_claims.quote: claimed sightings have occurred largely within the Kerinci Regency of central Sumatra and especially within the borders of Kerinci Seblat National Park

basis_claims.statement: In Finnish mythology Otso (also Karhu, Ohto, Kontio, Metsän kuningas and Mesikämmen) is a bear, the sacred king of animals and leader of the forest, deeply feared and respected by old Finnish tribes, and he appears in the national epic Kalevala.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Finlandia, Otso (juga Karhu, Ohto, Kontio, Metsän kuningas, dan Mesikämmen) adalah beruang, raja suci para hewan dan pemimpin hutan, yang sangat ditakuti dan dihormati suku-suku Finlandia kuno, dan ia muncul dalam epos nasional Kalevala.
basis_claims.quote: In Finnish mythology, Otso (also known as Karhu, Ohto, Kontio, Metsän kuningas, and Mesikämmen) is a bear, the sacred king of animals and leader of the forest. It was deeply feared and respected by old Finnish tribes. Otso appears in the Finnish national epic, the Kalevala.

basis_claims.statement: Otso is not a particular bear's spirit but the collective animistic spirit of all bears.
basis_claims.statement_id: Otso bukan roh seekor beruang tertentu, melainkan roh animistis kolektif seluruh beruang.
basis_claims.quote: Otso is not a particular individual bear spirit, but rather the collective animistic spirit of all bears.

basis_claims.statement: Otso ("broad forehead"), Ohto, Kontio, metsän kuningas ("king of the forest") and mesikämmen ("honey paw") are the main circumlocutions in Finnish mythology for the spirit of the bear, which must never be named.
basis_claims.statement_id: Otso ("si dahi lebar"), Ohto, Kontio, metsän kuningas ("raja hutan"), dan mesikämmen ("cakar madu") adalah sebutan kiasan utama dalam mitologi Finlandia untuk roh beruang, yang tidak boleh disebut namanya secara langsung.
basis_claims.quote: Otso (« le front large »), Ohto, Kontio, metsän kuningas (« le roi de la forêt »), et mesikämmen (« pattes de miel »), sont les principales circonlocutions utilisées dans la mythologie finnoise, pour désigner l'esprit de l'ours, que l'on ne doit jamais nommer.

basis_claims.statement: Pangu is a primordial creation figure in Chinese mythology who separates heaven from earth.
basis_claims.statement_id: Pangu adalah tokoh penciptaan purba dalam mitologi Tiongkok yang memisahkan langit dan bumi.
basis_claims.quote:
Pangu or Pan Gu (also sometimes spelled Peng Gu and P’an-ku)
(Chinese: 盤古; pinyin: Pángǔ ; PAN-koo) is a primordial being and creation figure in Chinese mythology and in Taoism. According to legend, Pangu separated heaven and earth, and his body later became geographic features such as mountains and flowing water.

basis_claims.statement: Depictions commonly present Pangu as a hairy giant bearing horns.
basis_claims.statement_id: Pangu lazim digambarkan sebagai raksasa berbulu dengan tanduk di kepala.
basis_claims.quote: Pangu inside the cosmic egg symbolizes Taiji. Pangu is usually depicted as a primitive, hairy giant with horns on his head.

basis_claims.statement: Often called the "keeper of the forest", he is considered the protector of the forests and their flora and fauna.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia sering disebut "penjaga hutan" dan dianggap pelindung hutan beserta flora dan faunanya.
basis_claims.quote: Often called the "keeper of the forest", he is thought of as the protector of the forests and their flora and fauna.

basis_claims.statement: He is pictured as a short old man of African descent with cloven hooves and a beard of leaves, strongly muscled and able to run faster than a deer.
