basis_claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua pendek keturunan Afrika berkuku belah dan berjenggot daun, berotot kuat, dan dapat berlari lebih cepat daripada rusa.
basis_claims.quote: His appearance is thought to be that of a short, old man of African descent with cloven hooves (or at least his left leg ends in a large hoof) and a beard of leaves, who, despite his age sports strong muscles and can run faster than a deer.

basis_claims.statement: His body is covered with donkey-like hair and small horns sprout from his forehead.
basis_claims.statement_id: Tubuhnya tertutup bulu seperti keledai dan tanduk kecil tumbuh di dahinya.
basis_claims.quote: His body is completely covered with hair like that of a donkey and small horns sprout from his forehead.

basis_claims.statement: He carries a hollowed-out bull's horn to warn animals of approaching hunters.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia membawa tanduk banteng berongga untuk memperingatkan hewan saat pemburu mendekat.
basis_claims.quote: He is also known to carry a hollowed-out bull's horn, which he uses to warn animals of hunters' approach.

fachan.depicted_variant: The Fachan from Campbell's Scottish account: a giant with exactly ONE centered eye, exactly ONE muscular arm growing from the MIDDLE OF THE CHEST ending in one hand, exactly ONE leg below the torso, and ONE stiff tuft of hair. Shoulders have no additional arms. Front full-body view on a rocky Highland slope makes each unusual feature unmistakable. Modest ragged waist cloth. No extra limbs, weapon or horns.

basis_claims.statement: In Scottish folklore the fachan (fachin, Direach Ghlinn Eitidh) is a monster or giant described by John Francis Campbell in Popular Tales of the West Highlands: one eye, one hand from the chest, one leg.
basis_claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia (Scottish folklore), fachan (fachin, fachen, Direach Ghlinn Eitidh, Dithreach, kerdil Glen Etive) monster atau raksasa menurut John Francis Campbell dalam Popular Tales of the West Highlands: satu mata, satu tangan dari dada, satu kaki; di Britania Raya.
basis_claims.quote: is a monster or giant described by John Francis Campbell in Popular Tales of the West Highlands as having a single eye in the middle of its face, a single hand protruding from its chest instead of arms, and a single leg emerging from its central axis.

basis_claims.statement: A single tuft of hair; per Campbell easier to uproot a mountain than bend it.
basis_claims.statement_id: Sejumput rambut; menurut Campbell lebih mudah mencabut gunung.
basis_claims.quote: It has a single tuft of hair on the top of its head, regarding which Campbell says "it were easier to take a mountain from the root than to bend that tuft."

basis_claims.statement: The manuscript monster: one eye in the forehead of a black face, one hand from the chest, one leg.
basis_claims.statement_id: Monster dalam naskah: satu mata di dahi wajah hitam, satu tangan dari dada, satu kaki; lebih mirip setan.
basis_claims.quote: and one eye in the forehead of his black-faced countenance, and one bare, hard, very hairy hand coming out of his chest, and one veiny, thick-soled leg supporting him

hag.depicted_variant: A wizened very old woman of European fairy-tale tradition, with a deeply lined angular face and gnarled hands, stooped beneath a rough modest shawl by an overgrown hedge. A tense enigmatic expression conveys the supernatural role. No pointed witch hat, broom, horns or oversized fantasy weapons.

basis_claims.statement: A hag is a wizened old woman, or a kind of fairy, witch, or goddess in folklore and children's tales.
basis_claims.statement_id: Hag adalah perempuan tua keriput, atau jenis peri, penyihir, atau dewi berwujud perempuan tersebut dalam cerita rakyat dan dongeng.
basis_claims.quote: A hag is a wizened old woman, or a kind of fairy, witch, or goddess having the appearance of such a woman, often found in folklore and children's tales such as "Hansel and Gretel".

basis_claims.statement: A hag is an imaginary folklore creature related to fairies, possessing supernatural powers and practicing witchcraft.
basis_claims.statement_id: Hag adalah makhluk imajiner cerita rakyat yang berkerabat dengan peri, memiliki kekuatan supranatural dan mempraktikkan sihir.
basis_claims.quote: Une hag est une créature imaginaire issue du folklore anglo-saxon et apparentée aux fées, ayant des pouvoirs surnaturels et pratiquant la sorcellerie.

basis_claims.statement: She has the appearance of an ugly and very old woman, malevolent and dangerous.
basis_claims.statement_id: Ia berpenampilan perempuan buruk rupa dan sangat tua, jahat serta berbahaya.
basis_claims.quote: Elle a l'apparence d'une femme laide et très vieille, malveillante et dangereuse.

henwen.depicted_variant: Henwen, Old White of Welsh legend: one large WHITE SOW with a rounded pig body, bristly coat, long snout, four short cloven-hoofed legs and curled tail, crossing a lush Welsh field of young grain. Female domestic-pig form only; no boar tusks, wings or extra animals emerging from her body.

basis_claims.statement: Henwen (Old White) is a sow of Welsh legend who per the Welsh Triads bore Cath Palug, fought by Cai (Sir Kay) or King Arthur.
basis_claims.statement_id: Henwen (Old White, Si Tua Putih) babi betina legenda Wales (Welsh), menurut Welsh Triads ibu Cath Palug yang dilawan Cai (Sir Kay) atau Raja Arthur (King Arthur); di Britania Raya.
basis_claims.quote: Henwen, meaning "Old White", is in Welsh legend a sow (female pig) which according to the Welsh Triads gave birth to Cath Palug, a monstrous cat depicted as combating with either Cai (Sir Kay) or King Arthur of Arthurian Legends.

basis_claims.statement: Her birthing boded ill for the Isle of Britain; chased into the sea at Penrhyn Awstin, she re-emerged at Aber Tarogi, Gwent Is-coed.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kelahirannya pertanda buruk bagi Pulau Britania (Isle of Britain); dikejar ke laut di Penrhyn Awstin, muncul di Aber Tarogi, Gwent Is-coed.
basis_claims.quote: The sow was ready to give birth, but this boded ill for the Isle of Britain, according to prophecy, so she was chased until she plunged into the sea at Penrhyn Awstin in Cornwall. The sow eventually re-emerges on land at Aber Tarogi in Gwent Is-coed (a subdivision of Gwent).

basis_claims.statement: At Maes Gwenith (Wheat Field) in Gwent a grain of wheat and a bee; at Llonion barley and a bee.
basis_claims.statement_id: Di Maes Gwenith (Wheat Field), Gwent: gandum dan lebah; di Llonion: jelai dan lebah.
basis_claims.quote: At Wheat Field (Maes Gwenith) in Gwent, a grain of wheat and a bee At Llonion in Pembroke/Dyfed, a grain of barley and a bee

hitodama.depicted_variant: One Japanese hitodama in the documented bluish-white variant: a softly luminous ROUND ghostly fireball with ONE long curving tadpole-like flame tail, floating just outside the open doorway of an old Japanese wooden house at night. It has no face, eyes, human body or wings. Let the round core and trailing tapering tail read clearly.

basis_claims.statement: A floating soul was called hitodama and imagined as round with a tadpole-like tail.
basis_claims.statement_id: Jiwa yang melayang disebut hitodama dan dibayangkan bundar berekor seperti kecebong.
basis_claims.quote: When the soul was floating free, it was called a hitodama, and it was imagined as being round with a tail, like a tadpole

basis_claims.statement: The library describes hitodama as ghostly fireballs lingering around the dead.
basis_claims.statement_id: Uraian perpustakaan menyebut hitodama gumpalan api gaib dekat jenazah.
basis_claims.quote: A hitodama (人魂) is a phosphorescent ball or blob of ghostly fire. Spiritual manifestations of the deceased, they emanate or linger around corpses.

basis_claims.statement: Reported colors include orange, red, and bluish white.
basis_claims.statement_id: Warna yang disebut antara lain jingga, merah, dan putih kebiruan.
basis_claims.quote: they come in a variety of colors, ranging from orange, red, or blueish white.

basis_claims.statement: A woodblock print shows a tailed hitodama leaving a house.
basis_claims.statement_id: Cetakan kayu menunjukkan hitodama berekor yang meninggalkan sebuah rumah.
basis_claims.quote: Woodblock relief print of a hitodama leaving a house, its distinctive wispy tail drifting behind it.
